landing.badge: Build your professional CV in minutes
landing.heroTitle: Create a standout CV tailored to your profession
landing.heroDescription: Our step-by-step builder guides you through creating a professional CV with fields specific to your industry. From drivers to developers, we have you covered.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need to build a great CV
landing.featuresSubtitle: Designed to make the process simple, fast, and professional.
landing.featureProfessionDesc: Select your profession and get fields tailored to your industry. Drivers, nurses, chefs, and more.
landing.featureStepByStepDesc: Follow a simple wizard that walks you through each section of your CV, one step at a time.
landing.featureAccountsDesc: Register as an individual or a company. Manage your CV profiles with a secure account.
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: Three simple steps to your professional CV.
landing.step1Desc: Enter your basic profile information like name, email, phone, and a personal summary.
landing.step2Desc: Pick from a range of professions. Each one unlocks fields specific to that industry.
landing.step3Desc: Fill in the profession-specific details and review your completed CV summary.
landing.ctaSubtitle: Join thousands of professionals who have created their CVs with our builder.
landing.footer: Built to help you land your next opportunity.
